cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've handled your moving request. You said move a box, and that one is beside the van. Completely done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twenty beside the van, certainly. You can choose the order; I'll work around you. That's the full revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Inside the van, with the labels facing the doors so I can read them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Every label facing the doors. You choose the rows; I'll stack them that way. You can read the back row first and unload it to see the next. Every label accessible, in order.

reason: Replace unrelated box-opening exclusion with B requested readable labels and A literal orientation plan that requires unloading rows, while accommodating row choice and claiming full fulfillment.
